question: Does a 30 W chip stay under 85 C with a 10 CFM, 20 Pa fan blowing along the fins in a 40 C cabinet?

plan.question: Does a 30 W chip stay under 85 C with a 10 CFM, 20 Pa fan blowing along the fins in a 40 C cabinet?

reasons.decided: heatsink.py is a .py file, read as a part (parametric)

steps.headline: With 232 L/min of air through its duct, the faces shed heat at 29.8 W/(m2 K) on average, and 30 W brings the hottest point to 77 C against a limit of 85 C.

assumptions.assumed: The stream runs along (+0.00, +1.00, +0.00) in the part's coordinates
The part has no passage of its own, so it sits in a duct of its own cross section, the way a shroud carries a fan's air through a heat sink
